proposals.action: Add to the Discovery/sourcing block: before waiving discovery, attempt at least two registered weekend-affinity domains with last_cited=None (dormant) from the preflight plan — institutional newsrooms, lab engineering blogs, journal primaries — plus any genuinely-new primary the week's reading surfaced; only waive if unreachable or off-topic, and name which were tried in the waiver reason. A new anchor that resolves to a hub domain (hf.co, github.com) does not count as a new primary.
proposals.evidence: Weekend waiver_rate=1.00 (source-health), top5_share=0.694, unique_domains=22 over 179 stories. 08-08-weekend waived because 'the week's genuinely new anchors were arXiv preprints, bioRxiv, and journal DOIs already in the registry; the one unregistered primary probed, deepgrove on Hugging Face, resolves to the hf.co hub'. Deficit is dormancy, not absence — same class rm-1 fixed for science on 2026-08-02 (commit 7f8e440), which is now demonstrably reactivating dormant domains (08-05-science hit newscenter.lbl.gov/elifesciences.org/noirlab.edu). Human-gated prompt patch.
